name: Twisted-pair indication
summary: A twisted-pair indication identifies the documented association of two conductors as a twisted pair.
description: A twisted-pair indication identifies the documented association of two conductors as a twisted pair. The pair association matters to conductor identification and termination, even when the two wires are drawn apart elsewhere. It does not by itself describe the cable screen or its termination.
Preserve pair numbers and polarity through connector and terminal schedules. If a screen is required, draw and document that interface separately.
readingNotes: Record pair identity and the actual conductor mapping separately.
Twisting and shielding are different cable attributes; a twist indication does not prove a screen is present.
drawingChecklist: Identify the associated device, circuit or diagram boundary.
Record pair identity and the actual conductor mapping separately.
Cross-reference the equipment data, terminal mapping or operating-state legend needed to interpret the form.
distinction: Twisting and shielding are different cable attributes; a twist indication does not prove a screen is present.
